# V-K remainder — fresh bounded execution after F01 observation

ROOT read the sealed F01 release child/manager returns, exact complete records
and source attribution, then verified their seals. The new persistent named
R7 rejection sequences and restored controls support routing the original
stored-assembly numerical-unavailability obligation to independent runtime
review. RV29 vk_f01_runtime_28 is assigned; final F01/V-K acceptance awaits it.
Debug P09 remains unqualified, with no retrospective inference of its reasons.

The original runtime01 is closed at its sealed stop and its18:38:50 boundary
has passed. ROOT now grants existing manager/I22 one fresh35-minute block from
recorded actual start for exactly the unchanged P10–P53 schedule. No build or
earlier process repeats. First run the original debug P10 NONE control once;
it must select exactly one test and PASS. The release diagnostic does not
substitute for it. Then proceed in the original order with the same four pinned
artifacts, archive, explicit fresh-process fault values and field projections.

Manager independently refreshes complete source/binary/fingerprint/argv/guard
bindings and issues the exact remaining schedule release. Reuse the existing
runner/supervision path; no new driver/collector/helper/tool. Check each actual
artifact/fault/argv before launch. Original controls and semantic stop rules
remain. No generic failure/exit/Ceiling, work-only drift or certificate-only
refusal substitutes for the registered criterion. Any new ambiguity or survivor
stops the sequence and returns to ROOT; no automatic diagnostic is granted.

Source look-ahead preserves these exact limits: F02/F03 can have an unobservable
top-level-Ceiling cause; value-only F04/F13/S1/S2 cannot substitute unavailability;
F17 needs its CLASS witness with the three InputDerived exceptions. Existing
example plans already expose F05 roles as well as precisions, F06's exact lost
THIN p128 StopRule, all F07 named bodies, R02's attributable verdict rather than
work-only changes, and R28's actual non-null verification shift count. These
notes do not change any mapping or authorize additional commands.

One A1 Cargo if unexpectedly needed is NOT permission to rebuild: no builds
are planned or granted here. Existing Rust/profile/features, cleared flags,
fresh explicit fault environments, M5 guard and bounded command supervision
remain. At five minutes inspect/stop/report an overrun; at35minutes stop any
remaining runtime. No automatic extension or hard per-process cap is claimed.
Preserve full raw streams and exact integer JSON; never round u64 records or
fingerprints through JavaScript numeric reserialization.

Write only A1 R/I22/vk_runtime_02 and matching manager subtree, and previously
assigned as-yet-unused P10–P53 log paths. No source/corpus/oracle/observation,
Git/index, Type2 delegation or cleanup. Later original records/failed attempts
remain unchanged. Final independent V-K/candidate review, hosted full-SHA CI,
exact-final-head DEC-025/GEN-8 and ROOT merge disposition still remain.

# F03 — both registered families through existing records

ROOT conditionally grants existing manager/I22 one10-minute observation block
only after RV29 confirms source/plan readiness of verification/vk_f03_plan_01
without unresolved findings. Proposal seal:
69dd47110c7264f078f45c87d8f26769aab89f505e1d6f19f35e0aec4d4c1c46.
The original runtime02 is sealed at its P13 stop; no later original call is
released by this diagnostic.

Use exactly the three proposed fresh NONE/F03/NONE processes on the existing
pinned normal-release vk_records artifact. Both original RF-CHAIN and RF-SKEW
families compute, with all66 existing show selectors, maximum10 members,
no parity, no --write, no build or new input. New non-overwriting log directory:
<wt>/scratch/i23/vk_prep/logs/f03_diagnostic_01. Rebind all189 source files,
binary/profile/features/raw fingerprints, input/argv and existing guard before
manager release and before each launch. Use the same existing supervision path.

Both controls must equal every complete frozen record and their distinct
report/control pins. Keep exact integer JSON and original raw streams. Inspect
every case and the complete candidate/verification/rejection sequence, with
source/row/body/member/spring attribution under RV29's F03-specific limits.
A reason name, generic Ceiling, work-only or certificate-only difference is
not fault credit. Retain mixed/terminal/ambiguous cases for explicit disposition;
do not select only favorable cases or invent missing private operands.

For a normal, complete and identity-bound D02, execute the already planned
D03 return control even if attribution is nonqualifying, then stop and return.
Identity/control/operational failure or incomplete/unsupported output stops
remaining execution. Inspect/stop/report a command at five minutes, and stop
remaining work at the actual10-minute boundary. No automatic extension.

Write only A1 R/I22/vk_f03_diagnostic_01 and matching manager subtree plus the
assigned new raw logs. No source/oracle/criterion/observation/helper/collector/
tool/Git/index change, cleanup or Type2 delegation. Original debugP13 remains
unqualified; P14 and the unrun P15/P16 pair need later ROOT disposition. Release
records never retroactively supply debug reasons or returned-control credit.
Return after the triplet; no original-schedule continuation follows automatically.
